The Comfort Club (Standard) membership includes two seasonal tune-ups per year (one cooling and one heating) for your HVAC system. Benefits include:

*   **No-Show Protection:** The $89 no-show fee is waived.
*   **Maintenance:** Annual reminders, filter-change notifications, and a written health report with each tune-up.

This plan costs $189 per year (or $16.99 per month) for one system, and $99 per year for each additional system at the same address.

*   An annual water heater flush and inspection.
*   An annual whole-home plumbing inspection.
*   15% off plumbing repairs.
